## Type of change

- [ ] Tool fix or improvement (does not change what is conformant)
- [ ] Specification change (approved by the Working Group; link the issue)
- [ ] Taking a new taxonomy release (link the release)
- [ ] Documentation

## Description

## Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass (README, *Tests*)
- [ ] `python3 tools/sync_skill_bundle.py --check` passes
- [ ] Derived files regenerated after changes to `spec/` or `examples/`
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added
- [ ] Example data is fictional and labelled "(fictional)"; no real evidence, personal data or keys
- [ ] New source files start with `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`
